name: CAH-010 session lifecycle reducer conformance
description: Language-neutral inputs and normalized outcomes for the pure Python and TypeScript session lifecycle reducers.

input_contract.wire_note: Wire events are complete protocol v1 envelopes and must be validated by the existing Pydantic or Zod boundary before reduction. Approval inputs are harness-owned domain facts only; they are not NDJSON protocol v1 messages and must not be added to the wire manifest by this fixture set.

normalization.optional_state_fields: Absent identifiers and session failure are represented by explicit JSON null values; last_sequence is zero until session.started is accepted.
normalization.failure_safety: Invariant failures contain stable classifications only and never copy task text, assistant text, failure messages, identifiers, or validator details.

policy.case_origin: Every case begins from canonical_initial_state; setup_inputs are reduced before the one subject input.
policy.ordering: After session.started, wire events must use the same session_id and the next monotonic sequence.
policy.correlation: session.cancelled correlates to cancel_command_id; every other wire event correlates to start_command_id.
policy.terminal: completed, cancelled, and failed are absorbing. Every later input returns terminal_state_absorbing and the exact prior state, including duplicate terminal events.
policy.replay: A replay stops on the first invariant failure. Replaying the same validated ordered inputs from idle must produce the same normalized result.

files.purpose: Every legal row in the initial transition matrix.
Complete deterministic histories for successful, cancelled, approval, race, and failure outcomes.
Illegal edges, guard failures, and strict absorbing-terminal behavior.
